scope: Read-only catalog query. No business rows or writes.

trigger.name: assets_protect_inventoried_terminal_state
trigger.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION radar_private.protect_inventoried_asset_terminal_state()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'radar_private'
AS $function$
begin
    if old.status = 'Inventariada'
        and new.status is distinct from old.status then
        raise exception 'ASSET_ALREADY_INVENTORIED: assets/%', old.id;
    end if;
    return new;
end
$function$
trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER assets_protect_inventoried_terminal_state BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.assets FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.status = 'Inventariada'::text) AND (new.status IS DISTINCT FROM old.status))) EXECUTE FUNCTION radar_private.protect_inventoried_asset_terminal_state()

versionTrigger.name: assets_touch_updated_at
versionTrigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER assets_touch_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.assets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at()
